# Preserve property presence in partial compose updates

The ComposeDetails schema uses optional: omit-key-if-missing for MV3 FCC IDs. Its API description tells callers to include only fields to change. At the inspected local Gecko binding revision, missing keys stay absent; explicitly present undefined and null keys normalize to null. Native setter code then uses undefined for no update and strict null for reset. Supported scoped pattern: keep key presence meaningful for this partial update API. Proposed manual rule: use an omission-preserving schema for update objects when absence means no change, and check the binding before generalizing null or undefined semantics. The fixed comm endpoint does not identify its paired Gecko revision.

Scope: mail/components/extensions.
